A purpose clause cannot rescue a head predicate the passage explicitly rejects; also 'redefining artistic mediums' targets form/medium, not the audience's perceptions of the world.

note: All five options are syntactically well-formed after 'it should be to', so discrimination is purely logical. The blank sits under a double constraint: (a) 'In other words / Rather' requires the positive counterpart of the negated tech-for-its-own-sake goal, and (b) it must restate the explicit definition 'great art challenges our perceptions of the world and forever changes our thoughts and feelings'.
